parameters.description:
`msg-to-bulkvs-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your BulkVS account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own BulkVS accounts — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional BulkVS accounts bound per enrollment.

Sign up for a BulkVS account at bulkvs.com and provision a phone number for SMS messaging from your Portal dashboard — that number becomes your sender ID. Set BULKVS_SMS_FROM_PHONE to that provisioned number and BULKVS_SMS_TO to the recipient's phone number, both in E.164 format (e.g. +15555550123).
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment BulkVS destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send an SMS to your own BulkVS account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's BULKVS_SMS_BASIC value (same format as BULKVS_SMS_BASIC)

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's BulkVS from phone

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's BULKVS_SMS_TO value (same format as BULKVS_SMS_TO)
